mentions.name: Open-niche indie videogame
mentions.description: A videogame built around a strong concept in an open niche; it remains an early-stage idea with false starts, held back by the difficulty of gaining visibility in a massively oversaturated indie game market.
mentions.problem: The indie game market is so massively oversaturated that it feels impossible to get eyeballs on the game.
mentions.source_excerpt: - a videogame. I've got a pretty killer idea in an open niche, but the indie market is so massively oversaturated that it feels impossible to get eyeballs.
